information.description:
True to their name, these dense-headed brutes are some of the toughest muscle the Valentinos have to offer. They’ll toss you to the dirt, slice you up, and then demand more of a fight before they’re done. And they don’t take no for an answer.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Valentinos).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Cost Per Dose: 100eb (Premium)

Is it a refreshment? A dietary supplement? A drug? Does it matter? Open up a can of AssKick, and try our new fruit flavor - purple!

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 4 Hours.
  • For the duration of the primary effect, the first damage the user suffers (after armor) in a Round is reduced by 1, or by 2 if the user also suffered a Critical Injury as part of taking the damage.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user’s COOL and TECH are reduced by 2 (Minimum 1).
  • The user feels ‘amped up’ and ‘ready to kick ass’ as if they lack a fear response. Do your best to roleplay accordingly.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • If the user wasn’t addicted to Asskick, they are now. While addicted, the user suffers a -2 penalty to Checks made with the following Skills unless they are currently experiencing the Primary Effect of AssKick: Athletics, Concentration, Endurance, Perception, Stealth, and Tactics.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "AssKick Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "AssKick Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
